output.reason: The brief checks the rise against the policy band (0.41% is under the 0.482% limit), shows the counts match the raw logs, explains the rollout gap as cache warm-up seen in other redeploys, and finds no effect on customers, so its advice not to roll back and not to mute alerts is sound and specific, even though the replica and month-end questions are still open.
